name: Shawn Mortensen
title: Board Clerk, Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District
years_of_service: Provisionally appointed to the Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District Board of Trustees in 2025; current term expires 2026, per the district's board directory.
background: Mortensen relocated his family to Los Gatos specifically for the school district's quality, per the district's board directory. He revived Los Gatos High School's Home & School Club in October 2020 during the pandemic and joined the Wildcat Foundation Board that same year.
He volunteered as team manager for Los Gatos Little League from 2018 to 2023 and for Los Gatos United Soccer from 2014 to 2018. He is a public school graduate from Grand Rapids, Michigan.

As Board Clerk, he is listed as a co-sponsor of Measure N, a $321,000,000 facilities bond covering Los Gatos High School and Saratoga High School, placed on the November 3, 2026 ballot; full detail on that measure is covered in content/measures/scc-measure-n-2026.json and not duplicated here.
attendance: No individually published meeting-attendance or voting-participation record for Board Clerk Mortensen was found. Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District does not appear to publish a per-trustee attendance scorecard on its public board pages; board agendas and minutes are posted but were not tallied individually within this session's tool budget.

past_measures_authored.title: Measure N, Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District School Bonds
past_measures_authored.outcome: On the November 3, 2026 ballot; outcome not yet known at time of writing.
